description: Defines the application's Room database class for managing Recipe and Note entities, including singleton implementation for database instance creation.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase, providing access to DAOs for recipes and notes, and a singleton pattern for database instantiation.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary with Room.databaseBuilder, applying destructive migration fallback.
